fact.content: engineer.md documents an explicit 'Command grammar' contract for requested_command.command but does not explicitly state that working_directory must be a relative path; the real test-runner Skill wrapper rejects an absolute or drive-prefixed working_directory (rejection_category: request_value_invalid). A live Engineer dispatch (agent abe70f4eef319978b, run-20260917-logicrepair-001, task T-LOGICREPAIR-DEMO) supplied an absolute Windows path as working_directory for its C-1 pre_test_requested command, and the wrapper correctly rejected it, halting Implementation before any test ran.
